name: webgameenhancer
description: Makes online games feel native: pointer lock, fullscreen, sensitivity, adblock

scripts.build:main: bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external electron --entry-naming main.js
scripts.build:preload: bun build src/preload/index.ts --outfile dist/preload.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron
scripts.build: bun run build:main && bun run build:preload
